headline: Bitcoin is holding near $75,700-76,200 after Thursday's selloff, US Nasdaq futures are bouncing, and the US jobs report lands at 20:30 Bangkok time.

market.asOf: All three from CoinGecko, read about 11:55 UTC Fri 6 Nov. CoinMarketCap showed similar prices at the same time (BTC $75,441, -6.33%; ETH $2,224, -8.13%; SOL $89.91, -6.92%). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Two indexes, both in Fear: Alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index is 28 (Fear), down from 50 (Neutral) yesterday, per its data feed; CoinMarketCap's own index shows 34.

stories.title: US tech futures bounce after the Asia rout; bitcoin waits near $76,000 for the jobs report
stories.summary: After Thursday's US chip-stock fall and Friday's more-than-6% drop in Seoul, US Nasdaq futures turned higher on Friday morning while European stocks fell. Bitcoin is near its lowest level since mid-September as traders wait for the US jobs report at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok).
points: At 05:15 ET, Nasdaq futures were up 1.8% and S&P 500 futures up 0.6%, while Dow futures fell 0.55% and Europe's Stoxx 600 fell 1%, per Dow Jones via MarketScreener.
South Korea's Kospi closed more than 6% lower, its worst day since 2025, per the same report.
Coinspeaker put bitcoin at $76,160, down 5.1% over 24 hours; Thursday's low of $75,208 was the lowest since 16 September.
More than $1B of leveraged bets were forcibly closed across crypto, including over $210M on ether, mostly bets on rising prices, per crypto.news.
Polymarket put the odds of a Fed rate hike on 9 Dec at 69%, down from 80% a day earlier, per Coinspeaker.

stories.title: US bitcoin funds lose $430M on 5 Nov and are now negative for the year
stories.summary: US bitcoin and ether funds (ETFs) saw large withdrawals on Thursday as markets fell, wiping out the buying after the midterm elections.
points: Bitcoin ETFs: about -$430M on 5 Nov; Fidelity's FBTC lost about $200M a day after taking in about $237M, and BlackRock's IBIT lost $105M, per Cointelegraph citing SoSoValue and Farside.
IBIT has had five straight days of outflows, more than $1B since 30 Oct, per Cointelegraph.
Bitcoin ETFs are now about $510M net negative for 2026, per Cointelegraph.
Ether ETFs: about -$100M, reversing a +$53M inflow the day before; BlackRock's ETHA lost $75.2M, per crypto.news citing SoSoValue.

sources.label: Cointelegraph: bitcoin and ether ETFs lose post-election gains

stories.title: Binance recovery: another batch of withdrawals reopens
stories.summary: Binance is reopening withdrawals in stages after its security incident. Its ninth recovery update reopened more coins on Friday, though some withdrawals may be delayed.
points: Update #9 began reopening withdrawals at 12:00 Beijing time (04:00 UTC) Friday for assets including USDE, PENDLE, ZRO, XRP and CAKE, per PANews.
The reopened networks include BSC, Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon and Arbitrum; Binance chose assets by user demand over the past week, per PANews.
Binance estimates about $6.34B was affected; about 95% had been replenished as of 2 Nov and about $2.85B frozen or intercepted as of 3 Nov, per TokenPost.

briefs.title: Nigeria sets stablecoin licensing rules
briefs.summary: Nigeria's central bank bans algorithmic stablecoins and gives existing operators 180 days to apply for a licence, per The Block.

briefs.title: Court limits Kalshi sports contracts
briefs.summary: A federal judge barred Kalshi from offering sports-event contracts on two California tribes' lands, per The Block.

briefs.title: IREN shifts from mining to AI
briefs.summary: IREN's mining revenue fell 58% from the prior quarter to $28M while AI cloud revenue rose 182% to about $200M; it aims to largely exit mining by 31 Dec, per The Block.

briefs.title: Ark buys Coinbase after its drop
briefs.summary: Coinbase fell 9.69% to $136.82 on Thursday; Ark bought 17,806 shares (about $2.44M) and trimmed Bullish and Bitmine, per The Block.

briefs.title: Greece passes a 10% crypto gains tax
briefs.summary: Greece will tax crypto gains at 10% from 1 Jan 2027, per KuCoin's daily report.

briefs.title: Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live
briefs.summary: The upgrade cuts Zcash block times from 75 to 25 seconds and sends 60% of fees to a reserve, per The Block.

briefs.title: Hyperliquid Strategies seeks CFTC registration
briefs.summary: The company filed to become a CFTC-registered futures broker (FCM) and reported $13.3M of quarterly revenue, per The Block.
